description: What the main window may ask the Rust side to do. Deliberately short: the shell is a proxy, and everything the product does goes over the daemon socket instead.

permissions.comment: The folder picker behind 'Add an app' and behind Settings > Watched folder. Open only - the shell never saves, asks or confirms through a native dialog.

Settings > Start Kitchen Table at login. Enable, disable and read back - the last one matters, because a toggle that cannot check itself would draw the owner's setting from memory and be wrong after any change made outside the app.
